blocks.text: WASHINGTON D.C., United States—US President Donald Trump signed an order Thursday designating the Oval Office as a national monument. This is meant to indicate the president’s redoubling of focus on beautifying the White House despite a brutal midterms defeat for his Republican Party. Critics accused Trump of ignoring voter concerns over the Iran war and affordability ahead of Tuesday’s midterm elections and obsessing, instead, on multiple construction and renovation projects in the capital. The day after Democrats won the House of Representatives and Senate, Trump virtually ignored the result and showed off construction work on his new White House ballroom instead. This […]...
